    c = s.output['ee_state']['components']
    return c['right_pos']['values'], c['right_axis_angle']['values'], c['right_gripper']['values'][0]

def screw_pos():

                     gripper_width=0.0, evidence_handles=handles, max_steps=96, max_translation=0.08)

# Lower into the container opening (rim top z=0.878), still holding
if abs(sp3[0]-0.58) < 0.03 and abs(sp3[1]) < 0.03 and sp3[2] > 0.9:
    low = [0.58, 0.0, 0.92]
    m6 = primitives.call(name='move_robowits_ee_to', arm='right', target_position=low, axis_angle=cur_aa,
                         gripper_width=0.0, evidence_handles=handles, max_steps=96, max_translation=0.08)

    ee4, aa4, gw4 = right_ee(); sp4 = screw_pos()
